subject: Private deployment deep-dive: isolation & air-gap readiness
messages:
From: Alex DaSilva <alex.dasilva@blackpine.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Architecture deep-dive: private deployment / isolation requirements

Hi Markus / Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at BlackPine is excited about Redwood's runtime. We want to set up a technical deep-dive to align on our private deployment requirements (VPC + on-prem + potentially air-gapped). Key topics we need covered:

- Network topology and egress controls
- Storage encryption and key management (KMS/HSM options)
- Air-gap/air-gapped bootstrap process and approved OS images
- Audit logs and retention (SOC2 checklist items)
- Rollout plan and maintenance windows

Are you available for a 90-minute session next week? Our initial availability: Tue 6/8 morning PDT, Wed 6/9 afternoon PDT, or Thu 6/10 any time.

Also attaching a short compliance checklist so you can see our baseline (I can share more on the call).

Thanks,
Alex

alex.dasilva@blackpine.com
(415) 555-0198

Proposed logistics: 90 minutes, we’ll run a short architecture walkthrough (30m), then a focused Q&A and runbook discussion (60m). Suggested attendees from our side: me (solutions architecture), Camila (customer success / deployment lead), and Lauren (security & compliance).

Slots that work for us:
- Wed 6/9 2:00–3:30 PM PDT
- Thu 6/10 10:00–11:30 AM PDT

Can you confirm which of those fits your team? If neither works, send a few alternatives and we’ll do our best to accommodate. Also — could you drop a quick network diagram (high level) into the Drive link below so our infra team can pre-read?

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxyz-network-diagrams
